turns.content: I've been trying to learn how to cook more at home. I made a pasta dish last night that actually turned out well.
That's great! What kind of pasta did you make?
A carbonara. It took me three attempts to get the eggs right without scrambling them.
Carbonara is tricky — the temperature control is everything. What finally worked for you?
Taking the pan off the heat before adding the egg mixture. Simple but I kept missing it.
That's the key move. Are you planning to try other Italian dishes?
I want to try cacio e pepe next. I hear it's even harder.
It is, but once you have carbonara down, you have the fundamentals. The ratio of pasta water is crucial.
